symbols.name: integer bit length
symbols.meaning: The bit length of each integer being multiplied, counting the bits the running time is measured against.
symbols.quote: The established fast multiplier is the known deterministic algorithm of Harvey and van der Hoeven that multiplies two integers, each with $n$ bits, in $O(n\log n)$ time, where $n$ denotes the bit length of each integer.

relations.quote: Within the argument, the multiplier runs on a [Fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-model.md).
